title: Find process IDs by name
summary: Use pgrep to find the Process ID (PID) of a running program by its name. This is useful when you need to know the PID to stop a process or check if it is running.

steps.explain: Run pgrep with the name of the process you are looking for. It will print the Process ID (PID) of any matching running process.
